name: Eleazar (Maccabee)
title: Maccabean brother who fell under a war elephant
summary: Eleazar Avaran was one of Mattathias' five sons and the brother of Judas Maccabeus. In the battle at Beth-Zechariah, he stabbed a war elephant he believed carried the king, but was crushed beneath the animal when it fell—a self-sacrificing act in the struggle for Jewish freedom.

keyEvents.title: Falls under the war elephant
keyEvents.description: Eleazar stabbed an elephant outfitted with royal armor, believing the king was riding it, but was killed when the elephant fell upon him.
